40k on shoes… no regrets, just vibes 💅👠

Generated with seedance 2.0 on
@yapper_so

PROMPT:

A 16-second cinematic influencer video set in a luxury walk-in closet with soft golden lighting, glass shelves, and mirrored walls, showcasing a collection of 10 designer heels. The camera slowly pushes in from 0–3s to reveal the full collection glowing on display. From 3–6s, quick elegant close-ups highlight each pair: crystal silver stilettos with glass-like heels, black satin pointed heels with pearl ankle straps, nude minimalist pumps with thin gold heels, red velvet statement heels with sculpted design, white lace-up ribbon heels, metallic gold platform heels with a chunky base, transparent PVC heels filled with floating glitter, pastel pink kitten heels with bow details, snake-pattern textured designer heels, and glossy black patent mirror-finish heels. From 6–10s, the influencer enters, gently picking up and showcasing different pairs while posing confidently in front of a mirror. From 10–13s, fast stylish cuts show her trying on nude pumps, walking in gold platforms, and adjusting lace-up heels, focusing on movement and shine. From 13–16s, she sits surrounded by all 10 pairs arranged around her in an ironic luxury vibe as the background audio plays: “I spent 40 thousand dollars on shoes and now I have no place to live,” ending with a soft cinematic fade-out.
